narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of Abraham; steady and grave.

the-lord.name: The Lord
the-lord.note: God speaking to Abraham and others; majestic, calm, sovereign.

abraham.name: Abraham
abraham.note: The patriarch (Abram until 17:5), near a hundred years old; reverent, hospitable, bold yet humble in pleading.

1.t: And after he began to be ninety and nine years old, the Lord appeared to him: and said unto him:
I am the Almighty God: walk before me, and be perfect.

2.t: And I will make my covenant between me and thee: and I will multiply thee exceedingly.

3.t: Abram fell flat on his face.

4.t: I am, and my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

5.t: Neither shall thy name be called any more Abram: but thou shalt be called Abraham: because I have made thee a father of many nations.

6.t: And I will make thee increase exceedingly, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

7.t: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee, and between thy seed after thee in their generations, by a perpetual covenant: to be a God to thee, and to thy seed after thee.

8.t: And I will give to thee, and to thy seed, the land of thy sojournment, all the land of Chanaan, for a perpetual possession, and I will be their God.

9.t: And thou therefore shalt keep my covenant, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

10.t: This is my covenant which you shall observe between me and you, and thy seed after thee: All the male-kind of you shall be circumcised.

11.t: And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, that it may be for a sign of the covenant between me and you.

12.t: An infant of eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every manchild in your generations: he that is born in the house, as well as the bought servant, shall be circumcised, and whosoever is not of your stock:

13.t: And my covenant shall be in your flesh for a perpetual covenant.

14.t: The male whose flesh of his foreskin shall not be circumcised, that soul shall be destroyed out of his people: because he hath broken my covenant.

15.t: Sarai thy wife thou shalt not call Sarai, but Sara.

16.t: And I will bless her, and of her I will give thee a son, whom I will bless, and he shall become nations, and kings of people shall spring from him.

17.t: Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, saying in his heart:
Shall a son, thinkest thou, be born to him that is a hundred years old? and shall Sara that is ninety years old bring forth?
17.q: unspoken thought ("saying in his heart") given to Abraham's voice

18.t: O that Ismael may live before thee.

19.t: Sara thy wife shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name Isaac, and I will establish my covenant with him for a perpetual covenant, and with his seed after him.

20.t: And as for Ismael I have also heard thee. Behold, I will bless him, and increase, and multiply him exceedingly: he shall beget twelve chiefs, and I will make him a great nation.

21.t: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sara shall bring forth to thee at this time in the next year.

22.t: And when he had left off speaking with him, God went up from Abraham.

23.t: And Abraham took Ismael his son, and all that were born in his house: and all whom he had bought, every male among the men of his house: and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskin forthwith the very same day, as God had commanded him.

24.t: Abraham was ninety and nine years old, when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.

25.t: And Ismael his son was full thirteen years old at the time of his circumcision.

26.t: The self-same day was Abraham circumcised and Ismael his son.

27.t: And all the men of his house, as well they that were born in his house, as the bought servants and strangers, were circumcised with him.
